'''Açorda''' is a traditional [[Portuguese cuisine|Portuguese]] dish composed of cubed or sliced stale bread with garlic, [[cilantro]], and [[poached eggs]]. It is a type of [[bread soup]], although some variants have a consistency closer to that of a porridge.

The version served in [[Alentejo Region|Alentejo]], açorda à Alentejana, is a classic of the region's cuisine.
